name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Housing scheme for urban poor providing financial assistance for construction of houses.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
eligibilityCriteria: Annual income up to ₹6 lakh for EWS, ₹6-12 lakh for LIG, ₹12-18 lakh for MIG
benefits: Interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹2.67 lakh
applicationProcess: Apply through PMAY portal with required documents
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, Income certificate, Bank account details

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Financial inclusion program to ensure access to financial services for all households.
eligibilityCriteria: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age
benefits: Zero balance bank account, RuPay debit card, overdraft facility
applicationProcess: Visit any bank branch with KYC documents
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, PAN card, Address proof

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support scheme for small and marginal farmers.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibilityCriteria: Small and marginal farmers owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments
applicationProcess: Register through Common Service Centers or online portal
requiredDocuments: Land ownership documents, Aadhaar card, Bank account details

name: Ayushman Bharat Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
eligibilityCriteria: Families identified as deprived rural families and selected occupational categories of urban workers
benefits: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year
applicationProcess: Automatic enrollment based on SECC 2011 data or through e-card generation
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, Ration card, Mobile number

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Clean cooking fuel scheme providing LPG connections to women from below poverty line households.
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
eligibilityCriteria: Women head of family from BPL households
benefits: Free LPG connection with financial support of ₹1,600
applicationProcess: Apply through nearest LPG distributor with required documents
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, BPL certificate, Bank account details

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small savings scheme for girl child welfare and education.
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
eligibilityCriteria: Girl child below 10 years of age
benefits: High interest rate, tax benefits under Section 80C
applicationProcess: Open account at post office or authorized bank branches
requiredDocuments: Birth certificate, Aadhaar card, Guardian's ID proof

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Business loan scheme for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
eligibilityCriteria: Indian citizen with business plan for non-farm income generating activity
benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories
applicationProcess: Apply through MUDRA affiliated banks or NBFCs
requiredDocuments: Business proof, Identity proof, Address proof

name: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)
description: Social security measure guaranteeing 100 days of wage employment in a financial year.
eligibilityCriteria: Adult members of any rural household
benefits: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per financial year
applicationProcess: Register at Gram Panchayat with job card application
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, Address proof, Bank account details

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit program for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
eligibilityCriteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first two live births
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in three installments
applicationProcess: Register at Anganwadi center or online portal
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, Bank account details, Pregnancy proof

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Single platform for students to apply for various government scholarships.
eligibilityCriteria: Students from Class 1 to PhD level based on specific scheme criteria
applicationProcess: Register and apply online through National Scholarship Portal
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card, Educational certificates, Income certificate
